item.author: 園芸の狼 (@gardeningwerewolf.bsky.social)
item.description:
#青空ごはん部
#入院中病院食

【 台風がやって来た 】

１９時現在、茨城県と千葉県の県境沖の太平洋上を進行中です… 茨城県から台風が上陸するのは統計取り始めて以来初めての事案だそうです… 今夏の酷暑日５日連続記録と云い、初記録の多い夏の日となりました … あゝ、窓の外に風の音が聴こえ始めました … 何事もなく通り過ぎれば良いのですが、関東平野は広うございます… 風が心配です… 関東平野は河川が多くございます… 氾濫出水が心配です… どうか災害にならない事を望みます… ☁☔☁

どうか皆さま、風雨には充分にお気を付け下さい … ☁☔☁

item.title: Income isn’t supposed to play a role in how much housing ass…
item.author: ProPublica (@propublica.org)
item.description:
Income isn’t supposed to play a role in how much housing assistance FEMA gives families.

But in some North Carolina counties, the highest-income homeowners received two to three times as much money after Hurricane Helene as those with lower incomes.

(Pub. Dec. 2025 w/ @theassemblync.bsky.social)

item.author: Mother Jones (@motherjones.com)
item.description:
Supreme Court justice Samuel Alito gained up to $2.9 million from his fossil fuel interests between 2005 and 2024, a new review of financial disclosures shows.

Yet the justice won’t recuse himself from key oil and gas cases.
